variables.name: RECORDINGS_DIR
variables.description: Where Frigate keeps recordings, snapshots and clips. It grows with the cameras and the retention you set in Frigate.

variables.name: CAMERAS
variables.description: The cameras' IPv4 addresses. Frigate pulls their RTSP streams on port 554.

variables.name: MQTT_HOST
variables.description: Home Assistant's MQTT broker, which Frigate sends events to on port 1883. Frigate's config can use it as {FRIGATE_MQTT_HOST}. Leave it unset to run Frigate without MQTT.

variables.name: FRIGATE_MQTT_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password of Frigate's MQTT user. Frigate's config reads it as {FRIGATE_MQTT_PASSWORD}.

variables.name: GO2RTC_CLIENTS
variables.description: Devices that may pull Frigate's camera restreams (the go2rtc API on 1984 and RTSP on 8554), such as Home Assistant. Leave it unset to keep them closed.

exclude.reason: The list of recorded events. The recordings it points to are not backed up.
